name: sdsa_quantize_write_index_qk_fp8_dim128_page_size64
description: Indexer keys and queries quantized to FP8 E4M3 at per-tensor scales in one launch: keys at their slots of a 64-key paged cache, queries at their rows. SM89 and newer.

slots.description: Slot mapping entries, one or more per key.

query_slots.description: Query row entries, one or more per query.

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
